title: Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?
abstract: arXiv:2610.01995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. translated_title: AI监督可以是零知识的吗？
translated_abstract: AI系统越来越多地基于机密数据产生输出，例如基于医疗记录给出的胜任能力评估，或基于候选药物的秘密结构预测其性质。在不泄露底层数据的前提下验证此类输出的正确性至关重要。最近的一系列工作研究了通过交互式证明和辩论来验证面向预言机辅助计算的AI输出，其中正确性可能取决于某种预言机，例如人类判断、物理实验或网络。这些工作侧重于由运行速度远快于计算本身的验证者进行的验证。然而，对于一般性的预言机辅助计算而言，这种高效验证是不可能实现的，因此这些工作不得不依赖额外的假设。我们转而关注隐私性：允许验证者以与计算量呈多项式关系的时间运行，我们探究面向预言机辅助计算的交互式论证是否能够做到零知识，从而使……
tldr: 该论文从隐私角度出发，在允许验证者以计算量多项式时间运行的前提下，研究面向预言机辅助计算的AI输出交互式论证能否实现零知识性，从而在不泄露机密数据的情况下验证AI输出的正确性。
en_tdlr: The paper shifts focus from efficient verification to privacy, asking whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge when the verifier runs in polynomial time, so that AI outputs on confidential data can be verified without revealing the underlying data.
